versions.content: Execution order of runnable entities within one OS task Type: valid Description: It shall be possible to describe the execution order of runnable entities with OS tasks across SW-Component borders. Rationale: The SW-C template can only describe constraints on the execution order of runnable entities within one SW-Component. But it has to be possible to describe execution order between SW Component's runnable entities mapped to a specific OS task to establish control flow algorithms where the control flow is passed from one SW-C to the next in a defined order. Use Case: Three periodically executed runnable entities are mapped to one OS task. It has to be defined in which order those runnable entities are to be executed when the OS task is activated.
